iis_infant_series_rate.long_name: NYC Citywide Immunization Registry: 7-vaccine series completion rate, 24-35 months
iis_infant_series_rate.short_description: Percentage of NYC children aged 24-35 months who completed the 7-vaccine series (4:3:1:3:3:1:4), by borough.
iis_infant_series_rate.long_description: Percentage of children aged 24-35 months living in NYC who have completed the combined 7-vaccine series (4 DTaP, 3 Polio, 1 MMR, 3 Hib, 3 HepB, 1 Varicella, 4 PCV), as reported to the NYC Citywide Immunization Registry (CIR). Borough estimates are weighted means of MODZCTA-level data using population denominators. Data updated semi-annually (Q2=June, Q4=December).

nyc_cir.name: NYC Citywide Immunization Registry (CIR)
nyc_cir.organization: NYC Department of Health and Mental Hygiene
nyc_cir.location: NYC Health Immunization Data GitHub Repository
nyc_cir.description: The NYC Citywide Immunization Registry (CIR) is a population-based immunization registry that tracks vaccinations for all children ages 0-18 years who live or receive vaccines in New York City. All healthcare providers vaccinating patients in NYC are required to report immunizations to the CIR. Data are released semi-annually (as of June 30 and December 31) and include routine childhood vaccines, flu vaccination, and HPV. Geographic granularity includes Modified ZIP Code Tabulation Areas (MODZCTAs) and borough summaries. Note: NYC children are not included in the NY State NYSIIS data; the CIR is a separate registry maintained by the NYC DOHMH.
nyc_cir.restrictions: Public domain. NYC DOHMH data is generally not subject to copyright restrictions. Attribution requested.
